overview_description.description: Agrona is an innovating company working on green based composites. Agrona is offering its new technology in manufacturing chipboard. The chipboard accounts for 60% of the global wood-based panel products and its market size in Egypt is more than 1 billion EGP, growing by double every year in the last decade, 90% of current consumption is covered by imports.
